(set-logic ALL)
(declare-fun cell1 () Int)
(declare-fun cell2 () Int)
(declare-fun cell3 () Int)
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell1 1) (= cell1 2) (= cell1 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell2 1) (= cell2 2) (= cell2 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell3 1) (= cell3 2) (= cell3 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell1 1) (= cell2 1) (= cell3 1)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell1 2) (= cell2 2) (= cell3 2)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) (= cell1 3) (= cell2 3) (= cell3 3)))
(check-sat-assuming ((= cell1 1) (= cell2 2)))
; Result: sat

(set-logic ALL)
(declare-fun cell1 () Int)
(declare-fun cell2 () Int)
(declare-fun cell3 () Int)
(assert (or (= cell1 1) (= cell1 2) (= cell1 3)))
(assert (or (= cell2 1) (= cell2 2) (= cell2 3)))
(assert (or (= cell3 1) (= cell3 2) (= cell3 3)))
(assert (distinct cell1 cell2 cell3))
(check-sat-assuming ((= cell1 1) (= cell2 2)))
; Result: sat
